query: I just rewrote the writing-commits skill in our marketplace repo. Before I open the PR, run its evals in omp against the version on main and show me the benchmark.
can you check whether our ticket-drafting skill actually makes codex's answers better than having no skill at all? the test prompts are already in its evals folder
People keep asking for changelog updates and our release-notes skill never kicks in. Measure how often it activates on realistic requests and tune its description.
Grade iteration 2 of the csv-cleanup skill evals against the assertions and open the review viewer so I can leave feedback on each output.
Set up evals for skills/sql-review: write three realistic test prompts with expected outputs, then do a first with-skill and without-skill run in Codex.
Is the new version of the planning skill worth it? Compare it with the old one on the same prompts, including time and token cost.
Our pr-description skill also fires when someone only wants a commit message. Build should-trigger and near-miss queries and fix the over-triggering.
벤치마크 결과에서 두 구성 모두 항상 통과하는 assertion이 뭔지 분석하고 다음 iteration을 돌려 줘. 지금 omp에서 작업 중이야.
Run the trigger eval for skills/review-helper with the candidate description in notes/description.txt, three runs per query, and tell me which near-misses still trigger.
I need numbers on the incident-report skill: pass rate, duration, and tokens with and without it on the prompts in its evals.json.
Write unit tests for the date parser in src/dates.ts and make sure they pass.
Evaluate this sentiment model's accuracy on data/test.csv and plot a confusion matrix.
Create a new agent skill that drafts weekly status reports from our Linear issues.
Review my SKILL.md for vague instructions and anything that should move into a reference file.
Install the skill-workflow plugin in Codex and confirm its skills show up.
Run scripts/check_plugins.py and fix whatever catalog error it reports.
Set up promptfoo to compare two system prompts for our support chatbot.
Benchmark how fast omp answers a 2k-token prompt with opus versus sonnet.
Review this pull request for correctness issues before I merge it.
이 스킬 설명 문장을 더 자연스러운 한국어로 다듬어 줘: '커밋 메시지를 작성할 때 사용한다.'
